0: Adopted June 3, 1986 ORDINANCE FOR ENFORCEMENT OF COUNTY ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH REGULATIONS AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING AND ENACTING A CODE OF ENFORCEMENT OF RULES AND REGULATIONS OF THE EVANS COUNTY BOARD OF HEALTH; EXPRESS ADOPTION OF APPLICABLE RULES AND REGULATIONS; DELEGATION OF DUTIES OF IMPLEMENTATION AND ENFORCEMENT TO EVANS COUNTY BOARD OF HEALTH; PROVISION FOR CRIMINAL PENALTIES FOR THE VIOLATION THEREOF; PROVIDING FOR PROVISION OF PROCEDURAL RIGHTS; ESTABLISHMENT OF JURISDICTION OF MAGISTRATE’S COURT OVER VIOLATORS OF THIS ORDINANCE. ALL FOR THE PROTECTION AND PRESERVATION OF THE PUBLIC HEALTH, SAFETY, AND WELFARE OF THE PEOPLE OF EVANS COUNTY, GEORGIA. I. There are currently in existence certain rules and regulations adopted by the Evans County Board of Health with the purpose of preserving the public health, safety, and welfare of citizens of Evans County, Georgia. This Ordinance specifically incorporates by reference the provision of the following rules and regulations which are in force at the time of the adoption of this Ordinance: a. II. The duty of implementation and enforcement of these regulations rests with the Evans County Board of Commissioners, and by virtue of this Ordinance is hereby expressly delegated to the Evans County Board of Health, who is hereby charged with promulgation of sufficient procedures for ensuring compliance with these rules and regulations by the citizens of Evans County or those individuals found within the boundaries of Evans County. The Evans County Board of Health is directed to implement procedures which will ensure that the citizens of Evans County or those individuals found within the boundaries of Evans County will receive all procedural rights to which they are entitled under the laws of the State of Georgia. III. Any violation of the rules and regulations hereby referenced shall be a violation of this Ordinance and shall be a misdemeanor offense. Any violator shall be subject to the imposition of a fine not to exceed $500.00 and/or imprisonment for a period not to exceed sixty (60) days. Any failure of payment of inspection fees listed within the fee schedule adopted by Evans County Board of Health and approved by the Evans County Board of Commissioners within 60 days of first notice may result in suspension of permit. IV. The magistrate’s court of Evans County shall have jurisdiction over violators of this Ordinance and all procedures for enforcement of such Ordinance shall be as provided in Article 4, Chapter 10 of Title 15, Official Code of Georgia. Complaints of violation of any provision of this Ordinance shall be brought before the magistrate’s court by a designated representative of the Evans County Board of Health and shall be prosecuted through that court.
